Asha (Sec): Security advisory: we are requiring phishing-resistant MFA (FIDO2/WebAuthn or security keys) for all employee and contractor accounts. Enrollment deadline: 2026-05-01. This is mandatory for console and admin access. Read the plan and enroll ASAP.
Nina (PeopleOps): Will People Ops run an enrollment campaign and help with lost keys?
Asha (Sec): Yes. People Ops + IT will coordinate. We will provide a kiosk schedule for onsite key issuance and a stipend for hardware tokens for remote staff.
Ben (IT): Tech details: SSO provider supports passkeys and hardware tokens. We will enable enforcement in two phases: 1) audit + reminders (now), 2) block non-compliant SSO sessions (after 2026-05-01).
Liam (Eng): What about service accounts and automation that use SSO? Any impact on CI or bots?
Asha (Sec): Service accounts and machine identities are excluded; this is human account MFA. CI/bots should continue using existing OAuth flows or service-to-service creds. If you use personal accounts for automation, migrate to service accounts.
sec-bot: Enrollment dashboard: weekly reporting enabled. Initial compliance snapshot: 42% enrolled. Weekly reminders scheduled every Mon. Link: https://redwood.internal/security/mfa-dashboard
Nina (PeopleOps): Stipend policy: up to $50 for USB/NFC keys; exceptions for accessibility approved case-by-case.
Ben (IT): Helpdesk plan: self-service passkey enrollment guide + emergency recovery (one-time codes via HR verification). Helpdesk will log all recovery events.
Liam (Eng): If I'm traveling and lose my key, what's the approved recovery flow? I can't access tools for a day.
helpdesk-bot: Recovery flow summary: 1) open HR ticket, 2) verify identity (video or in-person), 3) issue temporary 24h console pass and enroll replacement key. All events are audited.
Asha (Sec): Action items: 1) Enroll a phishing-resistant factor by 2026-05-01. 2) Managers: confirm direct reports in the enrollment dashboard by 2026-04-15. 3) If you need hardware, request via People Ops. Non-compliance after deadline will block console logins and require re-onboarding.
Nina (PeopleOps): I'll send calendar invites for onsite kiosk times and a company-wide email today. Please use the dashboard link to confirm enrollment status.
Asha (Sec): Office hours Friday 11am PT for questions. Ping me or IT for issues. :lock:
